audit_gap_correction.gap: The prior prediction freeze contained candidate logits but not immutable candidate family IDs, so an independent auditor could not reproduce hierarchical family-balanced SmoothMax.
audit_gap_correction.correction: Write one shared 371-row candidate-family manifest and exact candidate-index/family-ID payloads before parallel training, bind its SHA-256 in both checkpoints, both arm freezes, the pair freeze and run manifest, and independently recompute both pools before any GT access.

full_regression.command: python -c diagnostic builtins.zip shim followed by pytest -q
full_regression.shim_scope: Local Python 3.9 diagnostic compatibility only; ignores the unsupported strict keyword while preserving built-in zip behavior. Scientific source and Kaggle runtime are unchanged.

discarded_local_invocation.boundary: pytest collection before any test or scientific-data access
discarded_local_invocation.cause: the terminal default Python runtime has no NumPy
discarded_local_invocation.correction: rerun the identical focused suite with the existing btxrd-pseudomask environment; no package installation or source change

result_adoption_rule: A collaborator or local technique is promoted as an improvement only after a terminal independently audited result is better on the common predeclared metrics/gates; running code, oracle support or implementation availability alone is not improvement evidence.
next_gate: Wait for one meaningfully separated bounded R2 status check; if terminal, download and independently audit its GT-blind prediction freeze before evaluation. S1 remains unclaimed and unlaunched until the terminal R2 decision is synchronized and its predeclared launch condition is met.
